map.得率=480/1000×100=48.00%，属『化学浆』区间(40%–60%): Yield=480/1000×100=48.00%, which falls in the 'chemical pulp' range (40%–60%); pulp per tonne of raw material=480/1000=0.4800 t. Formula: yield = resulting pulp ÷ raw material × 100%. [SRC]
map.≥85% 高得率（机械浆），60%–85% 半化学浆，40%–60% 化学浆，<: ≥85% high yield (mechanical pulp), 60%–85% semi-chemical pulp, 40%–60% chemical pulp, <40% low yield. The higher the yield the more fully the fibres are used, but the strength is usually lower, so a trade-off is needed by product positioning.
map.为什么机械浆得率高但强度低？: Why does mechanical pulp have a high yield but low strength?
map.机械浆保留几乎全部纤维故得率高，但木素未被大量去除，纤维间结合弱、易返黄；化学浆: Mechanical pulp retains almost all the fibre so the yield is high, but lignin is not largely removed, so the fibre bonding is weak and the paper yellows easily; chemical pulp removes lignin and has a low yield but better strength and durability. Choose between them by end use.
map.得率能直接反映成本吗？: Can the yield directly reflect cost?
map.得率是关键因子：得率每升 1 个百分点，吨浆原料消耗同比例下降。但需结合能耗与化: The yield is a key factor: for every 1 percentage point of yield, raw material consumption per tonne of pulp drops proportionally. But it must be assessed together with energy and chemical costs, because high-yield mechanical pulp often consumes more power.
